summary: A 45-second talking-head Short that teaches one productivity tip straight to camera. It works because the payoff is promised in the first second and every 2 to 3 seconds something changes on screen.
hook: Opens mid-sentence on a tight close-up with a bold on-screen question, then a 115% punch-in on the first spoken word. No intro or logo, so the viewer is in the content within 1 second.

beats.label: Question hook
beats.what_happens: Close-up, bold caption asks the question the video answers.

beats.label: Problem setup
beats.what_happens: Creator explains the common mistake; two jump cuts and one punch-in.

beats.label: Three-step tip
beats.what_happens: Each step gets a numbered title card overlay and a screen-recording insert of about 3 seconds.

beats.label: Proof moment
beats.what_happens: Before and after split screen with a whoosh sound effect.

beats.label: Call to action
beats.what_happens: Creator points down at the caption; music swells and cuts hard to black.

style.pacing: Average shot about 2.4 s; jump cuts remove every pause over 0.3 s. Cuts land on music beats in the last 10 seconds.
style.framing: Medium close-up at eye level, alternating with 110 to 120% punch-ins every second or third cut. Screen recordings fill the full frame.
style.transitions: Hard cuts throughout, one whip pan into the proof section.
style.text_and_graphics: Word-by-word captions, 2 to 4 words per line, white bold sans-serif with a yellow highlight on the active word, placed in the lower third. Numbered title cards for each step.
style.audio: Low-volume lo-fi hip-hop at about 90 BPM under the voice; whoosh on transitions, a pop on each title card.
style.delivery: High energy, fast speech at roughly 180 words per minute, direct eye contact, frequent hand gestures toward the captions.
style.look: Bright, evenly lit home office, warm color grade, plant and bookshelf in the background, casual hoodie.

spoken_lines_internal: Stop doing this one thing every morning.
Here are three steps that changed my week.
